description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for 'git diff-tree' and related git diff commands. It sets up various trees and file states, then verifies the output of diff commands against expected results, focusing on handling of null SHA1 values.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, checks for success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.
